# orz-markdown

> orz-markdown is a Markdown renderer and a family of single-file, self-editing
> HTML tools. A `.md.html` document reads like a webpage, a `.slides.html` file
> presents as a slide deck, and a `.paged.html` file lays Markdown out as
> printable pages. Every format keeps editable Markdown source inside the file,
> with a Markdown text twin beside it (`x.md`, `x.slides.md`, `x.paged.md`).

## Start here

- [Homepage](https://markdown.orz.how/): product overview and live demo
- [The editable document family](https://markdown.orz.how/family.html): choose mdhtml, slides, or paged
- [Feature showcase](https://markdown.orz.how/features.html): math, diagrams, themes, rich formatting, and copy as Markdown
- [Guide](https://markdown.orz.how/guide.html): browser, CLI, and parser workflows, a glossary, and [upgrading 0.x files](https://markdown.orz.how/guide.html#upgrading)
- [Live editor](https://markdown.orz.how/editor.html): try orz-markdown without installing anything

## Product references

- [orz-mdhtml documents](https://markdown.orz.how/mdhtml.html): orz-mdhtml 1.0, text twin, header, themes, delivery, browser support, CLI, upgrading 0.x, embedding
- [orz-slides decks and layouts](https://markdown.orz.how/slides.html): orz-slides 1.0, text twin, layout grammar, themes, CLI
- [orz-paged documents and layout](https://markdown.orz.how/paged.html): orz-paged 1.0, templates, print themes, CLI
- [Document verifier](https://markdown.orz.how/verify.html)
